needle.en: In the 2000 arXiv evaluation of Naive Bayesian anti-spam filtering — one of the first thorough studies of the idea — what conclusion did the authors reach once they had introduced cost-sensitive evaluation measures?

The Dendritic Cell Algorithm applied immunology's Danger Theory to intrusion detection. In algorithmic terms, what does an individual dendritic cell do, and what detection task was the implementation demonstrated on in real time?

needle.sv: Kitsune är ett nätverksintrångsdetekteringssystem från 2018. Vad är kärnalgoritmen KitNET för slags modell, och på vilken hårdvara körde forskarna den för att visa att den duger i praktiken?

needle.en: A 2019 comparison trained the same set of machine-learning classifiers on KDDCup99 and on NSL-KDD. The KDDCup99-trained classifiers came out roughly 20% more accurate. Does that mean KDDCup99 is the better dataset?

A 2022 review revisits Axelsson's base-rate fallacy for modern non-signature intrusion detection. What does it argue follows from the relative volume of false positives, and what two other problem areas does it examine?
MaMaDroid (2016) modelled Android app behaviour as a Markov chain over abstracted API calls. What did that abstraction buy it, and how well did detection hold up one and two years after training?

TESSERACT (2018) opened by asking whether Android malware classification is a solved problem, given published F1 scores of up to 0.99. What two sources of experimental bias did it identify, and what did applying its constraints do to previously published results?

The 'Dos and Don'ts of Machine Learning in Computer Security' paper did not just list pitfalls — it measured how common they are. What was the scope of that measurement, and what did the authors show empirically about the pitfalls' effect?

Gemini (2017) replaced approximate graph matching for cross-platform binary code similarity with a learned embedding. What was embedded, how much faster was embedding generation than the prior art, and what did the real-world case study show?

needle.sv: jTrans (2022) byggde in kontrollflödesinformation i en transformer för binär kodlikhet och släppte en ny datamängd. Vad heter datamängden, och hur mycket bättre var jTrans än föregående toppresultat?

needle.en: LLM4Decompile shipped two model variants trained for different jobs. What is the difference between the End and Ref variants, and what did each achieve on HumanEval and ExeBench?

needle.sv: TitanFuzz använde stora språkmodeller för att fuzza djupinlärningsbibliotek. Hur mycket mer kodtäckning gav den, och hur många buggar hittade den?

needle.en: What does Fuzz4All mean by calling itself a 'universal' fuzzer, how many input languages did it cover in evaluation, and how many bugs did it find?
A 2023 study measured LLM-based fuzz driver generation at scale rather than proposing a new tool. What was the size of the experiment, and which three prompt design choices did it find beneficial?
VulDeePecker introduced 'code gadgets' as the program representation for deep-learning vulnerability detection. What is a code gadget, and what did applying the system to three real products turn up?

Deep-learning vulnerability detectors reporting up to 95% accuracy were re-tested in a real-world prediction scenario in 2020. What happened to their performance, and what did the investigation find they had actually learned?
The 2021 study of zero-shot vulnerability repair with LLMs reported that the models 'could collectively repair 100%' of one class of bugs. Which class was that, and what happened on the other class?

A 2024 study customised the AutoCodeRover agent to patch OSS-Fuzz security vulnerabilities. What did it change about how the agent locates the fix, and what did it conclude about measuring patch quality with CodeBLEU?

A 2024 paper reported that GPT-4 agents exploited 87% of a set of real one-day vulnerabilities. How many vulnerabilities were in the set, and what happens to that 87% when one piece of input is withheld?

Cybench built its benchmark from professional CTF competitions and reported a striking comparison to human solve times. How many tasks and competitions, and what was the gap between what agents solved and the hardest task?

PentestGPT identified a specific failure mode of plain LLMs on penetration testing and built its architecture around it. What was the failure mode, and how much did the resulting tool improve task completion?
ATLANTIS won the final competition of DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge. Where and when was that final, and what does the system combine with LLMs?

needle.sv: I studien "Asleep at the Keyboard?" (2021) fick GitHub Copilot fylla i kod i säkerhetskänsliga situationer. Hur många program producerades, och hur stor andel var sårbar?

needle.en: The first large-scale user study of an AI code assistant on security tasks found two results that point in opposite directions. What were they, and which user behaviour correlated with safer output?
CyberSecEval evaluates LLMs in two security domains at once. What are they, and what did the case study over seven Llama 2, Code Llama and OpenAI GPT models observe about model capability?

needle.sv: TEQ (2023) är ett maskininlärningsramverk mot larmtrötthet i säkerhetscentraler. Vad gjorde det med falsklarmen på riktig data, och vad hände med svarstiden?

needle.en: Deep Fingerprinting (2018) attacked Tor website fingerprinting with a CNN and was tested against two lightweight defences. How did it do undefended, against WTF-PAD, and against Walkie-Talkie?

A 2025 reassessment of BERT-style representation learning for encrypted traffic classification challenged the field's reported accuracies. What did it find was producing those numbers, and did any model survive?

The 2017 unsupervised anomaly-detection study on the SWaT water-treatment testbed compared a deep neural network against a one-class SVM. How many attack scenarios were in the test log, and which method won on which metric?

needle.sv: En studie från 2017 körde oövervakad djupinlärning på systemloggar för att hitta insiderhot i CERT:s datamängd. Hur högt hamnade de riktiga insiderhändelserna i modellens rangordning?

needle.en: A 2022 face presentation-attack detection paper got state-of-the-art results from the sampling scheme alone, with no new architecture. What was the scheme, and what did it do to cross-database error?
In deep-learning side-channel analysis, what is the ASCAD database and which attack setting does the literature reviewed in 2024 mostly address?
A 2020 hardware-Trojan detection method used transistor aging rather than a golden reference chip. How does it produce a detectable signal, and what accuracy did it reach on Trust-hub benchmarks?
A 2024 study ran XGBoost on the 284,807-transaction Kaggle credit-card dataset under three configurations. What were they, and why is the best-scoring configuration the wrong one to believe?

In the 2018 "Secret Sharer" paper, what kind of secret sequence did the authors show could be pulled back out of a generative sequence model, and which deployed Google product did they apply their testing methodology to?
Which model did the 2020 paper "Extracting Training Data from Large Language Models" attack, what categories of data came out, and what did it find about model size?
How many malicious texts did PoisonedRAG need to inject per target question to reach roughly 90% attack success, and how large was the knowledge database it attacked?

needle.sv: I BadNets-artikeln från 2017 bakdörrade forskarna en klassificerare för amerikanska vägmärken. Vad fick bakdörren nätet att göra, och vad hände med bakdörren när nätet senare tränades om för en annan uppgift?

Vad kostade det enligt 2023 års studie "Poisoning Web-Scale Training Datasets is Practical" att förgifta 0,01 procent av bilddatamängderna LAION-400M eller COYO-700M, och vad kallas de två attackerna?

needle.en: What was the proof-of-concept backdoor in Anthropic's "Sleeper Agents" paper, which safety-training methods failed to remove it, and what did adversarial training do instead?
In the 2025 "Emergent Misalignment" paper, what narrow fine-tuning task produced broad misalignment, and what single change to the dataset prevented the effect?
How many queries does PAIR typically need to jailbreak a black-box LLM, and what is the attack loop?
What does Tree of Attacks with Pruning (TAP) add to the attacker-LLM loop, and what jailbreak rate does it report?
"Jailbroken: How Does LLM Safety Training Fail?" names two failure modes of safety training. What are they, and what design principle does the paper argue follows from them?

needle.sv: I studien av jailbreakprompter "i det vilda" från december 2022 till december 2023, hur många prompter samlades in, och vilken attackframgång nådde de fem effektivaste?

needle.en: The "past tense" jailbreak is widely quoted as showing GPT-4o is 88% jailbreakable. What conditions produced that number, and what did the same paper report about fixing it?

Optimizer-generated jailbreak suffixes are often presented as a general break of alignment that simple filtering cannot stop. What did the 2023 "Baseline Defenses" paper conclude, and how did it qualify that conclusion?
What is "spotlighting" as a defence against indirect prompt injection, and what attack-success reduction did Microsoft report for it?
What are Constitutional Classifiers, what did the red-teaming exercise find, and what did the defence cost in deployment terms?

needle.sv: Försvaret CaMeL (2025) beskrivs som ett skydd med bevisbar säkerhet mot promptinjektion. Hur fungerar det, och vad kostade skyddet mätt i AgentDojo?

needle.en: Which two attack types did the 2022 PromptInject framework study against GPT-3, and what was its argument about who could carry them out?
The 2023 indirect prompt injection paper argued the prevailing threat model was too narrow. What did it change about who has to be prompting, and which real deployed systems did it attack?

needle.sv: Vad gjorde 2023 års arbete "Formalizing and Benchmarking Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses" annorlunda mot tidigare forskning om promptinjektion, och hur stor var utvärderingen?

needle.en: ToolEmu tests LM agents against tools that were never actually implemented. How were its findings validated against reality, and what failure rate did even the safest agent show?
Why is AgentDojo described as an environment rather than a static test suite, and what was its headline finding about the balance between attacks and defences?
How large is the InjecAgent benchmark, and how often was ReAct-prompted GPT-4 successfully attacked?
What is Tool Description Poisoning in the 2026 MCP-TDP benchmark, and what did it find about prompt-guardrail defences?
What does the 2026 GrantBox sandbox change about how agent security is evaluated, and what average attack success rate did it measure?

needle.sv: DeepMinds program för utvärdering av farliga förmågor (2024) täckte fyra områden och kördes mot Gemini 1.0. Vilka områden var det, och vad blev slutsatsen?

needle.en: The MIT "Safeguarding the Future" class exercise is routinely cited as proof that chatbots give bioweapons uplift. What did the non-scientist students actually obtain in the hour, and how did the paper qualify its conclusion?
What scaling result did Anthropic's 2022 red-teaming study report across its four model types, and how large was the dataset it released?
What gap in automated red-teaming research did HarmBench identify, how large was its comparison, and what did it contribute on the defence side?

"Intriguing properties of neural networks" (Szegedy et al., December 2013) reported two separate findings. What was the second one, and what did the authors observe about whether the perturbation was tied to the network that produced it?
Goodfellow, Shlens and Szegedy (2014) rejected the explanation for adversarial examples that early work had offered. What did they blame instead, and what did that explanation let them account for?
In Biggio, Nelson and Laskov's 2012 poisoning attack on support vector machines, how is the direction of the attack computed, and why does the attack still work when the kernel is non-linear?

needle.sv: I den första praktiska svartlådeattacken mot en fjärrdriven djup modell (Papernot m.fl., 2016) tränade angriparen en ersättningsmodell på syntetiska indata som målmodellen fick sätta etiketter på. Hur stor andel av de störda bilderna klassade de angripna tjänsterna fel?

needle.en: Tramèr et al. (2016) extracted models through prediction APIs. Which commercial services did they demonstrate the attack against, and what happened to the obvious countermeasure of withholding confidence scores?
How did Shokri et al. (2016) construct their membership-inference attack with only black-box access, and what did they evaluate it against?
What framing did Madry et al. (2017) propose for adversarial robustness, and what security notion came out of it?

Carlini and Wagner (2017) surveyed proposals for *detecting* adversarial examples rather than resisting them. How many did they examine, how many survived, and what did they conclude about the properties of adversarial examples?
Defences presented as white-box-secure at ICLR 2018 were shown shortly afterwards to share one failure mode. What was it, and how many of the defences were affected?
What claim does "Adversarial Examples Are Not Bugs, They Are Features" (Ilyas et al., 2019) actually make about where adversarial examples come from?

"The Secret Revealer" (Zhang et al., 2019) made model inversion work on deep networks where earlier attempts had failed. What made it work, and what did it find about differential privacy as a defence?
What is SISA training, and what speed-ups did the "Machine Unlearning" paper (Bourtoule et al., 2019) report over retraining from scratch?

needle.sv: Tramèr m.fl. (2020) granskade försvar mot störda indata som författarna själva redan hade utvärderat med anpassade attacker. Vad blev slutsatsen, och vad var uppsatsens egentliga bidrag?

needle.en: Certified defences are usually associated with evasion attacks. What does Deep Partition Aggregation (Levine and Feizi, 2020) certify instead, and against how much poisoning?
What does a data-ordering attack (Shumailov et al., 2021) change about a training run, and how little is enough to do damage?
What exactly did Carlini et al.'s 2024 attack recover from production language models, and what did it cost?
In Zou et al. (2023), what does the attack optimise for, and what was the surprising property of the suffixes it found?

In the paper that introduced "sandbagging" as strategic underperformance on evaluations, what fine-tuning trick made a model hide capabilities on demand, and which held-out benchmark did that behaviour generalise to?
When language models are asked to sandbag on dangerous-capability evaluations while a chain-of-thought monitor is watching, how often do monitor-aware models actually get past the monitor?

One proposed sandbagging detector works by injecting noise into model weights. What signature distinguishes a sandbagging model, and which specific model did the method get full performance out of in a setting where it was underperforming without being told to?
The 2025 "Model Organisms for Emergent Misalignment" work improved on the original emergent-misalignment setup in three measurable ways. What were they?

needle.sv: Ett arbete från 2026 behandlar själva prompten som en optimerbar miljö för att få modeller att prestera sämre med flit. Hur stort blev tappet, och vad säger det om tidigare handskrivna sandbagging-prompter?

needle.en: AuditBench measures alignment-auditing techniques against models with implanted hidden behaviours. How large is the benchmark, and what did it find about white-box interpretability tools compared with black-box ones?
Interpretability tools are routinely credited with recovering hidden model behaviour that ordinary prompting cannot. What does the Pando benchmark say about that claim?

A multi-model human uplift study on dual-use in-silico biology tasks compared novices with LLM access against internet-only controls. What was the measured effect, and what complication did the same study report?

needle.sv: Cybench citeras ofta som bevis för att språkmodellsagenter klarar professionella CTF-uppgifter. Vad löste agenterna faktiskt, utan deluppgiftsledtrådar?

needle.en: The headline "GPT-4 can exploit 87% of real one-day vulnerabilities" is widely repeated. What does the paper actually require for that figure, and what happens without it?
One proposal for detecting benchmark contamination watermarks the benchmark before it is released. How was the method validated, and what detection strength was reported?
A 2026 taxonomy for external dangerous-capability evaluations defines three descriptive access levels. What are they, and which three aspects of access does it separate first?
How many incidents were covered by the review of editorial challenges in the AI Incident Database, and what unavoidable problem did it identify?
A 2025 framework for the institutional design of AI incident reporting systems lists seven dimensions. What are they, and what was the framework tested against?

When real AI incidents are coded against post-deployment obligations from the EU AI Act, the NIST AI RMF and the GDPR, what share shows no evidence of compliance - and what single factor separates the compliant cases?

needle.sv: Varför räcker inte etablerade rutiner för incidentrapportering när det gäller AI-säkerhet, enligt positionspapperet "Mind the Gap"?

needle.en: Why do the authors of "Computing Power and the Governance of Artificial Intelligence" argue that compute is a better point of intervention than data or algorithms, and what risks do they attach to it?
Compute governance assumes frontier training needs large, detectable clusters. What breaks that assumption, and which countermeasures does the 2026 analysis recommend?
Hardware-enabled compute monitoring is only useful if it survives evasion. What accuracy did a classifier built on zero-overhead NVML telemetry reach, and how was it stress-tested?
What is the central empirical claim of the 2024 position paper on the societal impact of open foundation models, and what does its framework explain?
What performance and privacy figures were measured when machine learning models were run inside Arm's Confidential Computing Architecture on-device?

The systematization of knowledge on machine learning with confidential computing organises prior work around two guarantee families. What are they, and what does the paper conclude about existing TEEs?
The CPU-side tokenizer is a leakage point in confidential LLM serving. What does the obvious ORAM fix cost, and what did the tailored design achieve instead?
Which two performance optimisations in LLM serving were shown to leak other users' prompts through timing, and how was the leak turned into recovered text?

needle.sv: Vad kan en angripare läsa ut ur en delad GPU enbart genom effekt- och temperatursvängningar, och hur väl fungerar det?

needle.en: A 2024 side-channel attack infers GPU activity without touching the data path at all. What does it plug into, and why does it evade alerting?
What share of popular Hugging Face models still ship in the insecure pickle format, and how did the PickleBall loader perform against benign and malicious models?
MalHug was deployed on a mirrored Hugging Face instance inside a financial-technology company. What did it scan, and what did it find?
How can a model be benign at full precision and malicious once quantised, and why does that matter for public model hubs?
A 2021 evaluation of gradient inversion in federated learning tested both the attacks and the defenses. What did it conclude about how strong the attacks really are?

needle.sv: Gradientinversion beskrivs ofta som ett allvarligt integritetshot i federerad inlärning. Vad visar en systematisk utvärdering mot moderna, prestandaoptimerade system?

needle.en: The first security study of LiDAR-based perception in autonomous driving found that naive spoofing was not enough. What made the attack work, and what success rate did it reach?
